source.note: Japanese games company (founded May 2011); Premium Partner of the Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe and title sponsor of the Grand Prix de Paris since 2025 (France Galop partners page and France Galop ticketing page). Non-state; not prioritised for rating. 26 Sep 2026: original url www.prixarcartriomphe.com (event site, misspelled/host gone) replaced with the France Galop partners page, which lists Cygames as partner.
